review.notes: APPROVE: independent full-resolution re-review confirms every complementary device view represents the same unique central Josephson junction in series with the CPW center conductor; no SQUID, second physical junction, or shunt branch is introduced. Both CPW ends remain grounded, two-loop differential-flux gradiometry is consistent, control/readout are weak capacitive couplings, the half-flux positive-quartic expansion and f12>f01 ladder are correct, and the three Hyyppa 2022 metrics match the source. Minor ancillary hyphenation/spacing is nonblocking.
